album.blurb: Eight tracks that came from real experiences, real people and real feelings. Some are sad, some are angry, some are hopeful. If you've ever loved someone you couldn't quite have, stayed longer than you should have, or finally realised you deserved to move forward, there'll probably be something here you understand.
